results.question: List accounts with at least three cash deposits between ₹40,000 and ₹49,999 inside any 7-day window
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id FROM transactions AS d WHERE d.channel = 'CASH' AND d.direction = 'CR' AND d.amount_inr BETWEEN 40000 AND 49999.99 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions AS e WHERE e.account_id = d.account_id AND e.channel = 'CASH' AND e.direction = 'CR' AND e.amount_inr BETWEEN 40000 AND 49999.99 AND e.txn_ts >= d.txn_ts AND e.txn_ts < DATETIME(d.txn_ts, '+7 days')) >= 3 ORDER BY d.account_id LIMIT 200

results.question: Show the cash deposits between ₹40,000 and ₹49,999 on account A00108
results.sql: SELECT t.txn_id, t.txn_ts, t.amount_inr FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.account_id = 'A00108' AND t.channel = 'CASH' AND t.direction = 'CR' AND t.amount_inr >= 40000 AND t.amount_inr < 50000 ORDER BY t.txn_ts LIMIT 200

results.question: Which accounts were dormant for 90 days or more and then received at least ₹5,00,000 in credits within 7 days?
results.sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT account_id, txn_ts, LAG(txn_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts) AS prev_ts FROM transactions) SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id FROM ordered AS o WHERE JULIANDAY(o.txn_ts) - JULIANDAY(o.prev_ts) >= 90 AND (SELECT SUM(c.amount_inr) FROM transactions AS c WHERE c.account_id = o.account_id AND c.direction = 'CR' AND c.txn_ts >= o.txn_ts AND c.txn_ts < DATETIME(o.txn_ts, '+7 days')) >= 500000 ORDER BY o.account_id LIMIT 200

results.question: Which accounts had no transactions at all in March 2026?
results.sql: SELECT a.account_id FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.txn_ts >= '2026-03-01' AND t.txn_ts < '2026-04-01' WHERE t.txn_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.account_id LIMIT 200

results.question: List all SWIFT transactions with counterparties in high-risk countries
results.sql: SELECT txn_id, account_id, direction, amount_inr, counterparty_country FROM transactions WHERE counterparty_country IN ('IR', 'KP', 'MM', 'SY', 'YE', 'AF') AND channel = 'SWIFT' ORDER BY txn_id LIMIT 200

results.question: How many high-risk-country SWIFT transfers were there per country, and what was their total value?
results.sql: SELECT counterparty_country AS country, COUNT(txn_id) AS transfers, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 2) AS value FROM transactions WHERE channel = 'SWIFT' AND counterparty_country IN ('IR', 'KP', 'MM', 'SY', 'YE', 'AF') GROUP BY counterparty_country ORDER BY transfers DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the total value of outward SWIFT transfers to high-risk countries?
results.failure_reason: result multiset differs; missing e.g. [(9679638.68,)], unexpected e.g. [(20033734.0,)]
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 2) AS total_outward FROM transactions WHERE channel = 'SWIFT' AND direction = 'CR' AND counterparty_country IN ('IR', 'KP', 'MM', 'SY', 'YE', 'AF') LIMIT 200

results.question: How many open alerts are there for each rule code?
results.sql: SELECT rule_code, COUNT(alert_id) AS open_alerts FROM alerts WHERE status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY rule_code ORDER BY open_alerts DESC, rule_code LIMIT 200

results.question: Which alert rules have an average score above 70?
results.sql: SELECT rule_code, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score FROM alerts GROUP BY rule_code HAVING AVG(score) > 70 ORDER BY rule_code LIMIT 200

results.question: How many alerts are there in each status?
results.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerts GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: For each account type, how many accounts have at least one escalated alert?
results.sql: SELECT account_type, COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM alerts WHERE status = 'ESCALATED') GROUP BY account_type LIMIT 200

results.question: Show the name, PAN and phone number of customer C00010
results.sql: SELECT c.full_name AS name, c.pan AS pan_number, c.phone AS mobile FROM customers AS c WHERE c.customer_id = 'C00010' LIMIT 200

results.question: List the accounts held by customer C00010 with their account numbers and status
results.sql: SELECT account_id, account_number, status FROM accounts WHERE customer_id = 'C00010' ORDER BY account_id LIMIT 200

results.question: Which high-risk customers have accounts with open alerts?
results.sql: SELECT customer_id, full_name FROM customers WHERE risk_rating = 'HIGH' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM accounts WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM alerts WHERE status = 'OPEN')) ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 200

results.question: List the account IDs of high-risk customers that have open alerts
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM alerts WHERE status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY account_id LIMIT 200

results.question: What was the total amount credited per customer city in June 2026?
results.sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(j.amount_inr), 2) FROM customers AS c JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id, t.amount_inr FROM transactions AS t JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.direction = 'CR' AND t.txn_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND t.txn_ts < '2026-07-01') AS j ON j.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY c.city LIMIT 200

results.question: How many transactions were made through each channel?

results.question: What is the average transaction amount per channel, rounded to 2 decimals?
results.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY channel LIMIT 200

results.question: Which 10 accounts have the highest total debit amount?
results.sql: SELECT account_id, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 2) AS total_debits FROM transactions WHERE direction = 'DR' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY total_debits DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: How many transactions were made in March 2026?

results.question: Show the number of transactions and total value per month
results.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(txn_ts, 1, 7) AS yyyymm, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 2) FROM transactions GROUP BY yyyymm ORDER BY yyyymm LIMIT 200

results.question: How many cash deposits were made on weekends?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE channel = 'CASH' AND direction = 'CR' AND (STRFTIME('%w', txn_ts) = '0' OR STRFTIME('%w', txn_ts) = '6') LIMIT 200
